positive_design.detail: Four defects that geometric gates cannot see. See residual_findings V1-V4.

residual_findings.finding: The light and dark brand-mark variants are selected the wrong way round on slides. build_deck picks marks['dark'] for a light slide and marks['light'] for a dark slide, so a light slide gets the paper-filled wordmark on a paper ground and a dark slide gets the ink-filled wordmark on an ink ground. Only the diamond reads; the wordmark is effectively invisible on every slide. The masthead lockup is correct.
residual_findings.evidence: qa/screenshots/round3/deck-cover_1920x1080.png (dark slide, ink wordmark on ink), qa/screenshots/round3/deck-parameters-pane-par-chart_1920x1080.png (light slide, paper wordmark on paper)
residual_findings.why_not_caught_earlier: The mark is an , so its text is not in the DOM and no font, contrast or overlap rule applies to it. Only looking at the rendered pixels reveals it.
residual_findings.fix: one-character change: invert the conditional in build_deck's mark selection

residual_findings.artifact: the admission chart, reading page and slide 3 pane 3
residual_findings.finding: The plot SVG uses preserveAspectRatio="none" so the data-point circles are stretched into wide ellipses at every desktop width. The step line and the threshold marker are unaffected because their strokes are non-scaling.
residual_findings.why_not_caught_earlier: Distortion is not overflow, clipping, overlap or an undersized box, so no gate rule covers it.
residual_findings.fix: draw the points with a non-scaling marker, or drop preserveAspectRatio="none" and map the series to the rendered pixel box

residual_findings.finding: The chart is stretched to the full slide width at a short fixed height and roughly the lower half of the slide is empty. The installed contract calls out oversized empty containers as not meeting the design goal.
residual_findings.why_not_caught_earlier: Occupied area is a diagnostic, not a gate threshold; the pane passes every geometric rule.
residual_findings.fix: let the chart grow with available height on a slide and pair it with the probe in a two-column composition

residual_findings.gate: positive design / legibility of the standalone graphic
residual_findings.finding: The three edge labels are centred in the gaps between stage cards but drawn at a y that falls inside the cards' vertical band, and they are wider than the gaps, so each label paints over the neighbouring card borders. 'approved records are archived' is about 190px wide in a gap of about 70px.
residual_findings.why_not_caught_earlier: The SVG geometry check (qa/svg-check.json) compares text bounding boxes against the viewBox and against each other. Both pass: no text leaves the viewBox and no two text boxes overlap. Text over a rectangle is not text over text.
residual_findings.fix: raise the label baseline above the card tops, or place the labels under the curve inside the gap and shorten them to the verb phrase

residual_findings.finding: The slide element itself never scrolls at any measured viewport, so the installed desktop-stage-scroll gate passes everywhere. A stricter check on the inner .slide__body region reports 25 remaining cases of component scrolling with a visible themed scrollbar.

residual_findings.finding: The installed extractor walked the repository and ingested 8 of the 9 files. It has no .html reader, so the previously generated docs/handbooks/html/operations.html was absent from the extracted model; its stale retry value was read directly from the frozen input. The installed skill was not modified. The gap is disclosed on the delivered page (Rebuild appendix) and in the retained source inventory.

The global navigation was changed from sticky to static in correction round 1, because a sticky bar overlaps page text in every scrolled state and the detector treats that as a text collision. The consequence is that reaching the global Presentation Mode button from deep in the page requires scrolling to the top, so 'close the deck and return to where I was' returns the reader to the top in that particular flow. Entering the deck without moving the page restores the exact offset (verified: 4000 -> 4000).
